title: ChatGPT-written hints in the OATutor system produce the only learning gain significant against a no-hint control in a 274-person online algebra and statistics experiment (UC Berkeley, 2023)
summary: In a UC Berkeley experiment with 274 Mechanical Turk workers in 2023, ChatGPT-written math hints gave a 17% pre-to-post gain, the only gain significant against a no-hint control.
account: Zachary Pardos and Shreya Bhandari of the University of California, Berkeley ran an online experiment from 28 February to 10 May 2023 with 274 Amazon Mechanical Turk workers who held at least a high school degree. The authors randomly assigned each participant to one of four subjects drawn from OpenStax textbooks, elementary, intermediate or college algebra or statistics, and to one of three hint conditions in the open-source OATutor system: hints written by human tutors, worked-solution hints generated by the 15 December version of ChatGPT 3.5, or no hints. A three-item pre-test and post-test measured learning. The ChatGPT group showed a 17.00 percent learning gain from pre-test to post-test. The authors report that only the ChatGPT condition produced gains significant against the no-hint control, and that gains did not differ significantly between ChatGPT and human-tutor hints. ChatGPT hints failed the authors' quality checks on 32 percent of problems, a rate that a self-consistency technique cut to nearly zero for algebra. The learners were adult crowd workers in short sessions, and problems with figures were left out. PLOS ONE published the study on 24 May 2024.
purpose: ChatGPT is a general-purpose chatbot. The authors used it to write hints for tutoring software, and learning from those hints was the purpose of the study.
system: ChatGPT 3.5 ("Dec 15 Version"), prompted to write worked-solution hints shown in the OATutor tutoring system
deployer: University of California, Berkeley (Pardos and Bhandari), in an online study on Amazon Mechanical Turk
location: Online (Amazon Mechanical Turk); study run from Berkeley, California, United States
